name: OAAT (Tune)

policy._this_is_a_policy: Ce qu'il faut supposer quand l'appareil n'a rien dit, pas une mesure. Une fiche qui connaît son vrai chiffre l'emporte.

note: Tune's own transport. Its ceiling is NOT recorded here because this catalogue does not know it - it is a question for the people who wrote it, not something to infer. What makes it worth its own entry rather than folding into the transparent group is the second measurement: a receiver that can be instrumented can report how full its buffer is, and buffer occupancy is the indicator that moves BEFORE a drop-out, where a throughput figure only confirms one afterwards.
